legacy.body:
## Summary

Define how ETL jobs retry, avoid duplicate effects, and respect source limits.

## Context

Dashboards ingest external data with different rate limits. Retries can duplicate
records or hammer a source.

## Expected outcome

- Retry policy and backoff.
- Idempotency keys for loads.
- Rate-limit handling.
- Timeout and cancellation.
- Observability for failures.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Retries are bounded.
- [ ] A duplicate load is safe.
- [ ] Rate limits are respected.
- [ ] Timeouts are configurable.
- [ ] Failures are observable.
- [ ] No unbounded retry loop exists.

## References

- Concurrency: ops/templates#39
- State: ops/templates#38
- Runtime: ops/templates#33
